description_en: Queries web page observation quality data
description_zh: 查询网页观测质量数据
name: DescribeUrlObservationData

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation to obtain the site ID
parameters.help_zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~ListSites~~)接口获取
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en:
The start time for the data query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据的开始时间。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time for the data query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据的结束时间点。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The URL of the web page to monitor
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en:
The device platform. If this parameter is left empty, data for all platforms is queried.

PC

Mobile
parameters.help_zh:
设备平台，参数为空则查询全部。

PC

Mobile
parameters.name: client_platform

parameters.help_en:
The metric to query.

TTFB: Measures the time from when a resource request is initiated to when the first byte of the response begins to arrive.
FCP: Measures the time from when the page starts loading to when any part of the page content is rendered on the screen.
LCP: Reports the render time of the largest image or text block visible within the viewport.
CLS: A metric that measures the largest burst of layout shift scores for every unexpected layout shift that occurs throughout the entire lifecycle of a page.
INP: Measures the responsiveness of a page, specifically how long it takes for the page to visibly respond to user input.
FID: Measures the time from when a user first interacts with a page to when the browser is actually able to begin processing event handlers in response to that interaction
parameters.help_zh:
检测的指标数据。

TTFB：度量资源发起请求到响应的第一个字节开始到达之间的时间。
FCP：度量从页面开始加载到页面内容的任何部分在屏幕上呈现这之间的时间。
LCP：报告视区中可见的最大图像或文本块的呈现时间。
CLS：一个度量页面整个生命周期内发生的每一次意外布局变化的最大布局突变分数的度量值。
INP：度量页面的响应能力，页面需要多长时间以看得见的方式响应用户输入。
FID：度量从用户第一次与页面交互到浏览器实际能够为响应该交互开始处理事件处理程序这之间的时间
parameters.name: metric
